claim: Erdman testified that the CIA obstructed the Director's Initiatives Group's COVID-origins review — refusing to provide the documents needed to understand why the agency's analytic standards on the origin question were violated, illegally monitoring the computers and communications of the DIG personnel running the investigation, and firing a CIA contractor who was assisting the COVID-origins inquiry one day after he met with the DIG.

sources.label: Written Testimony of James E. Erdman III, U.S. Senate HSGAC, May 13, 2026 — 'Key findings'
sources.quote: The CIA did not comply with lawful oversight requests during the DIG's investigation. ... The CIA refused to provide information necessary to understand why analytic standards at the CIA were violated. ... The CIA illegally monitored the computer and phone usage of DIG personnel in DNI spaces, their investigations, and contact with whistleblowers. ... One CIA contractor assisting with the DIG's COVID origins investigation was fired one day after meeting with the DIG.

notes: Group B (sworn allegation) from capture DYYLACQDnG1. Scope deliberately narrowed to the COVID-origins relevance: this card documents only the CIA's obstruction and surveillance of the DIG's COVID-origins review — the refusal to produce the COVID analytic-tradecraft documents (which is also why records -001/-002 cannot be independently checked against CIA files), the monitoring of the DIG investigators, and the firing of the COVID-origins contractor-whistleblower a day after he met the DIG. Erdman's testimony ALSO describes CIA conduct that is NOT COVID-related — the Steve Baker / January-6-pipe-bomb memo that triggered a broader monitoring episode, and the post-shutdown clawback of 40 boxes of JFK assassination files and MKULTRA records queued for declassification. Those were originally folded into this card; they are off-topic for a COVID chapter and have been removed (they live in the archived full testimony at sources/captures/DYYLACQDnG1/hearing/written-testimony-erdman.txt if a future intelligence/declassification chapter wants them). These are attributed allegations under oath; the CIA disputes the DIG's characterizations. Companion to 2026-covid-origins-001/-002/-003/-006.
